name: Road to De Other Side: after the Chimeric Embryo dies, a released player is revived on its arena
contract: Issue #10293: on Ascension, releasing in Road to De Other Side revived you in the room of the last boss killed. Muzah and Drak'math set that checkpoint when they die (#11222), the Chimeric Embryo (162716) did not, so a player who released after it was sent back to an earlier start. Expected: once the Embryo dies, a player of that run who releases is revived on the middle of the Embryo arena (304.43, -206.08, 341.84), the same safe spot the boss lifts fallen players to.
